subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should outbound Telegram multi-media sends use automatic sendMediaGroup grouping on the existing mediaUrls paths, a new explicit media-group action/parameter, or remain sequential for now?
rationale: This adds user-visible Telegram message-tool/API behavior and spans direct actions, reply delivery, and outbound payload delivery; the permanent API shape and fallback policy are maintainer product choices, not a safe autonomous cleanup decision.

options.title: Group existing mediaUrls when eligible
options.body: Recommended: reuse the current durable mediaUrls path and add sendMediaGroup only at the Telegram-owned send boundary for Telegram-groupable 2-10 media sets, with sequential fallback.

options.title: Adopt an explicit album action
options.body: Review or port the draft fork PR's explicit send-media-group/filePaths shape if maintainers want album behavior to be opt-in rather than automatic.

options.title: Keep sequential sends for now
options.body: Document the current behavior and defer album grouping if the extra Telegram API surface is not worth the complexity yet.

recommendation.title: Group existing mediaUrls when eligible
recommendation.body: Recommended: reuse the current durable mediaUrls path and add sendMediaGroup only at the Telegram-owned send boundary for Telegram-groupable 2-10 media sets, with sequential fallback.
